peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 6.9% above its local comparables; 82 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (69.9): 5.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 73 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Context, not scored: resales in 75% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Ang Mo Kio MRT about 140 m, Mayflower MRT about 1,270 m; closer than 103 of 116 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 4 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Jing Shan Primary School about 470 m; more than 86 of 116 similar developments (the same as 18). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 100 m), more than 106 of 116 similar developments (the same as 6); nearest hawker centre Blk 724 Ang Mo Kio Market about 290 m; nearest park Ang Mo Kio Town Garden East about 130 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestPark.name: Ang Mo Kio Town Garden East

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: Teck Ghee MRT about 530 m (LTA target 2030) and Tavistock MRT about 1,480 m (LTA target 2030), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other condo development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 11 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 145 resales (145 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (34) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 145 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 7 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 145 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 169 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14.2%). Planning-area private resales +12.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
